scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:web && bun run build:landing
scripts.build:native: cd remake && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo build --release -p conker-server -p conker-client
scripts.build:web: cd remake && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net WASM_OPT="${WASM_OPT:-$(ls ../lab/tools/emsdk/upstream/bin/wasm-opt 2>/dev/null)}" sh web/build.sh web
scripts.build:landing: cd remake/web/app && bun install && bun run build
scripts.pack: cd remake && rom="$PWD/../Conker's Bad Fur Day (USA).z64" && CONKER_ROM="${CONKER_ROM:-$rom}" CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo run --release -p conker-extract -- pack --map 2d --map 30 --map 34 --map 3f --background 2d=../lab/audio/captures/background_loop.wav --background 30=../lab/audio/map30/background_loop.wav --background 34=../lab/audio/map34/background_loop.wav --background 3f=../lab/audio/map3f/background_loop.wav
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run serve
scripts.test: cd remake && rom="$PWD/../Conker's Bad Fur Day (USA).z64" && CONKER_ROM="${CONKER_ROM:-$rom}" CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo test -q -p conker-rules -p conker-sim -p conker-bots -p conker-anim -p conker-server -p conker-client -p conker-assets -p conker-extract -p extract-scene -p extract-character
scripts.check: cd remake && cargo fmt --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-net cargo clippy -q -p conker-rules -p conker-sim -p conker-bots -p conker-anim -p conker-server -p conker-client -p conker-assets -p conker-extract -p extract-scene -p extract-character -- -D warnings && cd web/app && bun run check
